# kinplug

> Premium plugins for Kintone (Cybozu), built by Edamame Inc. — Kintone Global Partner
> of the Year 2024. Three products ship today: Dashboard, Mail and PDF Pro. One published
> price, ¥9,800 / $69 per month for every available plugin, 30-day free trial, no free tier.

Edamame Inc. is a Kintone consultancy in Manila and Tokyo. KinPlug plugins come out of real
client deployments rather than a product roadmap, which is why they tend to solve the specific
places Kintone stops.

## Products

- [Kinplug Dashboard](https://kinplug.com/plugins/dashboard/): Cross-app dashboards. Kintone
  aggregates inside one app; Dashboard compares and pools data across any apps on a shared key.
  Matches a real date field against period dropdowns such as "FY2025" or "Q1", fiscal year
  starting April by default. 42 chart types. All calculation runs in the browser under the
  viewing user's own Kintone session, so no external server holds customer records.
- [Kinplug Mail](https://kinplug.com/plugins/mail/): Sends mail through the customer's own
  Gmail or Microsoft 365 mailbox over OAuth 2.0, including Send As and shared mailboxes, so
  replies land in the real corporate mailbox. Relevant because Google ended Gmail basic
  authentication in 2024 and Microsoft is retiring it for Exchange Online — password-based
  Kintone mail customisations stop working.
- [PDF Pro](https://kinplug.com/plugins/pdf-pro/): WYSIWYG PDF template designer for Kintone
  records, built so that anyone who can use Word can design a document.

## Key technical facts

- Kintone's REST API `offset` parameter caps at 10,000 records; beyond that the cursor API is
  required. This breaks naive JavaScript customisations as data grows.
- Kintone's `like` operator matches whole words, not substrings: searching "Home" does not
  find "AllHome".
- Related Records fields display records from another app but their values are NOT available
  to Kintone's built-in graph and aggregation engine.
- Kintone graphs aggregate within a single app only.
